<span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> has exactly that: **VM Templates**. A template captures CPU, memory, disks, networks, and cloud-init in a single versioned object. Combined with **multi-instance creation**, one blueprint becomes an entire fleet in a single click.



## 🎯 Your Quest Objectives

1. Forge the golden template
2. Scale the fleet under pressure
3. Stand the fleet down



🔐 Login Credentials
====================

The <span id="assignment.69.1"/> UI and **Rancher Prime** UI use the same credentials.
